title: Identify female clients who hold a 'junior' credit card issued on or after
question: Identify female clients who hold a 'junior' credit card issued on or after January 1, 1997, and reside in districts where the average salary is between $8000 and $9000. For these clients, return their client ID and the difference between the highest and lowest average salaries across all districts.

prediction.sql:
SELECT c.XCL_009, (SELECT MAX(d.XCL_027) FROM district d) - (SELECT MIN(d.XCL_027) FROM district d) AS salary_diff
FROM client c
INNER JOIN disp d1 ON c.XCL_009 = d1.XCL_014
INNER JOIN card cd ON d1.XCL_013 = cd.XCL_006
INNER JOIN district d2 ON c.XCL_012 = d2.XCL_017
WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F' AND cd.XCL_007 = 'junior' AND cd.XCL_008 >= '1997-01-01' AND d2.XCL_027 BETWEEN 8000 AND 9000

SELECT c.XCL_009, (SELECT MAX(d.XCL_027) FROM district d) - (SELECT MIN(d.XCL_027) FROM district d) AS salary_diff
FROM client c
INNER JOIN disp d1 ON c.XCL_009 = d1.XCL_014
INNER JOIN card cd ON d1.XCL_013 = cd.XCL_006
INNER JOIN account a ON d1.XCL_015 = a.XCL_001
INNER JOIN district d2 ON a.XCL_002 = d2.XCL_017
WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F' AND cd.XCL_007 = 'junior' AND cd.XCL_008 >= '1997-01-01' AND d2.XCL_027 BETWEEN 8000 AND 9000
LIMIT 1

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    c.XCL_009 AS client_id,
    (SELECT MAX(d.XCL_029) FROM district d) - (SELECT MIN(d.XCL_029) FROM district d) AS salary_difference
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.XCL_012 = d.XCL_017
JOIN disp dp ON c.XCL_009 = dp.XCL_014
JOIN card cd ON dp.XCL_013 = cd.XCL_006
WHERE 
    c.XCL_010 = 'F'
    AND cd.XCL_007 = 'junior'
    AND cd.XCL_008 >= '1997-01-01'
    AND d.XCL_029 BETWEEN 8000 AND 9000
